Bzip2.Proofs.Bwt.decode_eq_spec : ∀ (L : List UInt8) (tt : Array UInt32) (k t : ℕ),
  0 < L.length →
    Bzip2.Proofs.Bwt.TableMatches L tt → t < L.length → Bzip2.Proofs.Bwt.inverseWalk tt k t = Bzip2.Spec.Bwt.walk L k t
Bzip2.Proofs.Bwt.decode_bwt : ∀ (L : List UInt8) (p : ℕ) (raw : Array UInt32) (c : Array ℕ),
  Bzip2.Spec.Bwt.ValidInput L p →
    Bzip2.Proofs.Bwt.TableMatches L (Bzip2.Oracle.Decompress.Block.links raw c) →
      Bzip2.Proofs.Bwt.inverseWalk (Bzip2.Oracle.Decompress.Block.links raw c) L.length
          ((Bzip2.Oracle.Decompress.Block.links raw c)[p]! >>> 8).toNat =
        Bzip2.Spec.Bwt.decodeBwt L p
